messages:
Pri (AE): Opening thread for AuroraTech POC. They want to swap vendors with minimal client-side changes. Key asks: strict parity on three regulatory templates, clear per-request billing breakdown for audits, SSO + BYOK, and a sandbox for smoke. SE/Sec/Pricing please advise.

Samir (SE): Context: Aurora calls a single /v1/generate endpoint syncronously today. ~600k tokens/day, mostly short prompts (avg 50 tokens). Top concerns: deterministic templates, tokenization differences, and retry semantics affecting billing.

Vera (Aurora Eng): We have 3 regulatory templates where output must be identical. Anything else needs semantic parity. We also require per-request token logs to reconcile with our billing system. Sandbox + IP allowlist needed.

Samir (SE): Plan: 1) Provide a thin adapter example mapping their /v1/generate -> /responses to avoid client changes. 2) Run a parity harness: golden exact-match rate, token delta, and semantic similarity. 3) Provide per-request traces (request_id, tokens_in/out, model) for reconciliation.

Samir (SE): Adapter snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"{{prompt}}","model":"redwood-prod-1","max_tokens":{{max}}}'
```

Nate (Security): BYOK/KMS: supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses our envelope encryption by default; BYOK on Hosted not available today. SSO/SCIM: supported for console provisioning. Audit logs: default masked retention 90d; can extend on Dedicated via contract. We'll need their filled vendor questionnaire.

Nate (Security): Also: confirm whether per-request traces will include raw prompts or hashed inputs for privacy. Masking can be toggled per contract.

Clara (Pricing): Ballpark hosted generation: $0.0065 / 1k tokens. Dedicated reserved estimate for 600k/day: ~ $45k/month (6mo), with better rates on 12mo. Onboarding fee for Private and PS for KMS automation may apply. I'll run detailed scenarios if they share last 90d invoices.

Vera (Aurora Eng): Acceptance criteria from our audit team: 1) 3 golden templates -> 100% exact match. 2) Token accounting delta <=2% over 2k prompts. 3) Semantic sim >=0.95 for non-deterministic prompts. 4) Per-request trace available and matches our hashes. 5) p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated for short prompts. 6) No silent truncation on retries.

Samir (SE): We'll run a 200-prompts smoke tonight in sandbox, then full 2k run during POC week. We'll include tokenizer outputs side-by-side so you can reconcile.

infra-bot: staging aurora-poc ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/aurora (id: 7210). egress IPs: 35.204.88.11, 35.204.88.12. Use key AUR_TEST_7210.

Vera (Aurora Eng): Got it. Sending golden templates + 2k sample set via secure link now. Also need allowlist CIDRs for Dedicated.

Nate (Security): I'll prefill the vendor questionnaire and flag BYOK SLA + log retention items for legal. Also will note that trace export to customer S3 is an add-on.

Clara (Pricing): I'll prepare three scenarios: hosted monthly, 6mo Dedicated, 12mo Dedicated, and include PS line for KMS. Also include estimated savings if they enable prefix caching and batching.

Pri (AE): Scheduling 30m kickoff with AuroraTech + SE + Sec + Pricing tomorrow 9am PT. Agenda: parity scope, security Qs, pricing scenarios, and allowlisting.

Vera (Aurora Eng): If we get the adapter + harness today we can kick off the smoke tonight.

Samir (SE): Dropping adapter repo & runbook after thread. TL;DR: clone repo, set REDWOOD_KEY, run ./smoke.sh --sample 200. :thumbsup:

Pri (AE): Marking CRM: aurora-swap-poc-2024. Will update after kickoff. :rocket:
